§2016-08.05 SMOKING IN WORKPLACES PROHIBITED. (A) Smoking is prohibited in all indoor workplaces within places of employment. This prohibition includes, but is not limited to, common work areas, auditoriums, classrooms, conference and meeting rooms, private offices, elevators, hallways, medical facilities, cafeterias, employee lounges, stairs and bathrooms. (B) It is the duty of the employer, or his/her designee or assignee, to inform each employee of this prohibition on smoking in the workplace. (C) Employers may elect as an exception to the smoking prohibition to provide an enclosed smoking area for the use by employees during normal work hours. §2016-08.06 SMOKING IN OUTDOOR ARENAS PROHIBITED. Smoking is prohibited in outdoor arena seating areas, concession areas, and bathrooms. The owners, lessees or operators of arena venues may designate a smoking area(s) in areas of the arena not

premises when asked to do so may be considered a trespasser and may be subject to a charge of criminal trespass in the third degree pursuant to KRS 511.080 in addition to the penalty stated in §2016-08.99(A) .
